name: The Setai Tel Aviv Hotel
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary perfectly captures Tel Aviv's sophisticated energy while offering serene Asian-inspired elegance just steps from the Mediterranean.
whats_special: The Setai Tel Aviv occupies a prime corner of the historic American Colony, featuring minimalist suites with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the sea. The hotel's signature rooftop infinity pool creates the illusion of swimming into the Mediterranean horizon, while the spa draws inspiration from traditional Asian wellness philosophies.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing suite on floors 6-8 for the most spectacular sunrise views over the Mediterranean, and time your rooftop pool visits for golden hour when the entire Tel Aviv skyline glows.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of Carmel Market's vibrant food scene and the trendy Rothschild Boulevard. The nearby Tel Aviv Port offers world-class dining and nightlife, while Jaffa's ancient stone streets and artist quarters are just a 10-minute stroll south along the beach promenade.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct beach access
Sophisticated contemporary design and luxurious amenities
Outstanding dining experiences with Mediterranean cuisine
cons: Urban beach location can be busy during peak season
